integrity: Proof establishes the full theorem, and the embedded Python checker independently implements supporting finite exact-rational and numerical diagnostics; these tests do not certify an infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Requires a support function of spherical-harmonic degree at most three in dimension three; the fourth plane has a specified position. No claim for unrestricted convex bodies or arbitrary four planes. Historical equivalence to an unindexed finite-view theorem has not been excluded.
title: Four circular shadows sharply determine cubic-bandlimited convex bodies
